# StudentCalc

> Free calculators and study tools for students, with an initial focus on Sri Lankan
> students. No account required. Calculator inputs are processed in the browser and are
> not sent to a server; planning tools use browser localStorage only.

StudentCalc is an independent student utility site. It is not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or an official channel of any government department, examination authority, or
university — including Sri Lanka's Department of Examinations or University Grants
Commission (UGC).

## Calculators
- [GPA Calculator](/calculators/gpa): Calculate GPA from subject grades and credits using a configurable 4.0-style scale.
- [Percentage Calculator](/calculators/percentage): Calculate percentage of, percentage increase/decrease, and percentage difference.
- [Grade Calculator](/calculators/grade): Convert numeric marks into letter grades using a configurable grading scale.
- [Attendance Calculator](/calculators/attendance): Calculate attendance percentage, classes you can still miss, and classes needed to reach a target.
- [Average Calculator](/calculators/average): Calculate the mean of a set of numbers.
- [Weighted Average Calculator](/calculators/weighted-average): Calculate a weighted average from values and their weights.
- [Marks Needed Calculator](/calculators/marks-needed): Calculate the score required on remaining assessments to reach a target grade.
- [Exam Score Calculator](/calculators/exam-score): Track current weighted exam score across multiple graded components.
- [Study Hours Calculator](/calculators/study-hours): Estimate available study hours before an exam and how to split them across subjects.

## Student Tools
- [Exam Countdown](/tools/exam-countdown): Live countdown timer to an exam date and time.
- [Study Timer](/tools/study-timer): A simple distraction-free study timer with custom duration.
- [Pomodoro](/tools/pomodoro): Configurable focus/break session timer.
- [Study Planner](/tools/study-planner): Splits available study hours across subjects by priority. Saved locally in the browser.
- [Semester Planner](/tools/semester-planner): Tracks modules, assignments, and exam deadlines. Saved locally in the browser.
- [Assignment Deadline Tracker](/tools/assignment-deadline): Tracks individual assignment due dates. Saved locally in the browser.

## Sri Lankan A/L Resources
- [A/L Hub](/a-level): Overview of Sri Lankan A/L resources on the site.
- [Z-Score](/a-level/z-score): Explains the Z-score concept (Z = (X − mean) / standard deviation) and provides an educational calculator. This is explicitly NOT the official UGC admissions Z-score methodology.
- [University Selection](/a-level/university-selection): General, non-numeric overview of how post-A/L university selection works. Does not publish specific cutoffs — those change yearly and are set by the UGC.
- [Subjects](/a-level/subjects): Directory of A/L subject streams (Physical Science, Biological Science, Commerce, Arts, Technology).
- [Resources](/a-level/resources): Links to the official Department of Examinations and UGC websites.

## Policies
- [About](/about)
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): No accounts, no server-side storage of calculator inputs, localStorage for planners only, no analytics or ads currently installed.
- [Terms of Use](/terms)
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Calculations are informational; grading/attendance scales are examples, not universal standards; not an official examination or admissions authority.
- [FAQ](/faq)
